title: Follower Analyzer: Unfollowers
short: See who unfollowed you and who doesn't follow back. Data stays on your phone.
full:
Follower Analyzer shows who isn't following you back, who unfollowed you, and how your followers change over time — all on one screen. Your follower lists are processed on your phone, not on our servers.

What you can do:
• Not following back: accounts you follow that don't follow you
• Unfollowers: who stopped following you between two snapshots
• Fans: accounts that follow you that you don't follow back
• New followers, mutuals, pending requests and more — 14 lists in total
• Mark accounts you've handled and hide them from your lists
• Copy or share usernames

Two ways to add data:
• Official data archive: import the JSON file Instagram gives you — no login needed, zero risk
• Live fetch: sign in on Instagram's own login page for an instant snapshot

Privacy first:
• You sign in on Instagram's own page; the app never sees or stores your password
• No account or sign-up required
• Follower lists stay on your device
• Open source on GitHub

Available in 14 languages.

Not affiliated with Instagram or Meta. For a zero-risk option, use the official data archive.

Questions or suggestions: bilalfarukozdemir@gmail.com
notes: Fixed being asked to log in to Instagram and enter a security code on every fetch; you now stay signed in on this device. The connected account is shown, and there is a new "Sign in with another account" button.
